posture_checks_empty_subtitle: Add your first posture check to enhance access security.
posture_checks_wizard_subtitle: To activate localization, make sure at least one Edge component is connected.
posture_checks_wizard_step_operating_sys: Define who can connect to your network.
posture_checks_wizard_operating_systems_: Only explicitly configured operating systems are allowed. For example, if you configure Windows and macOS, Linux, iOS, and Android devices will fail the posture check by default.
Require devices to have the latest security updates installed.
Evaluates security update compliance for the selected period (excluding general OS updates).
Evaluates Android security patch level compliance for the selected period.
Optionally define additional parameters for access control.
posture_checks_wizard_summary_prerelease: Allow pre-release versions of the XGuard client.
posture_checks_wizard_step_client_versio: Define what version of the XGuard client you would like to support
posture_checks_wizard_client_version_not: “XGuard versions” includes major releases as well as all subsequent patch updates with fixes and improvements.
posture_checks_wizard_client_version_pre: Allow users who run pre-release versions of the XGuard client to access the system.
If you want to allow access for users testing pre-release (non-stable) versions of the XGuard client, enable this option.
posture_checks_wizard_details_note: Provide a clear and descriptive name for the posture check policy that makes its purpose easy to understand when it is applied, along with an optional short description that explains the context and conditions of the rule (e.g., Windows 11 restrictions, minimum XGuard version 2.0).
posture_checks_wizard_step_summary_descr: Check your posture check settings before submitting.
posture_checks_wizard_summary_banner: Only systems matching the conditions below will be allowed to access the VPN once this posture check is assigned to a location. All users who do not meet these requirements will be denied access.
posture_checks_wizard_confirm_modal_cont:
Before applying this posture check, please confirm that at least one System Administrator will still meet all the required conditions.

If no administrator meets these requirements, admin access to the system may be lost.
posture_checks_edit_xguard_note: “XGuard versions” includes major releases as well as all subsequent patch updates with fixes and improvements.
posture_checks_page_description: Posture policies are rule sets a device must meet to connect to a location. The XGuard client reports facts about its device when it connects; this is an attestation by the client, not proof.
posture_checks_form_section_systems_text: Only the systems you enable here may connect. Leave all of them off to allow any system.
posture_checks_form_helper_client_versio: A version such as 2.2.0. Leave empty for any version.
posture_checks_form_helper_versions: Examples: {examples}. Leave empty for any version.
posture_checks_form_label_update_age: Last security update at most this many days ago
posture_checks_form_label_patch_age: Security patch level at most this many days old
posture_checks_form_error_version: Use a version such as 14.5 or 2.2.0.
posture_checks_form_error_age: Enter a number of days from 1 to {max}.
posture_checks_save_failed: Failed to save the posture policy
posture_checks_delete_confirm_body: Delete posture policy **{name}**? Its locations stop checking devices against it.
posture_checks_delete_failed: Failed to delete the posture policy
posture_checks_duplicate_failed: Failed to duplicate the posture policy
posture_device_modal_never: This device has not reported its posture yet. It reports when it connects to a location with posture policies.
posture_device_modal_attestation: These facts are what the XGuard client reported about its device. They are an attestation by the client, not proof.
